questions.q: In theory, each grant application was judged only on its own merits. The audit later revealed that reviewers were influenced by earlier applications, so the evidence showed ______.
o: likewise
otherwise
meanwhile
therefore

exp.trans: 理论上，每份资助申请应只按自身质量评审；审计却发现评委受到之前申请的影响，所以证据表明实际情况并非如此。
exp.structure: In theory提出预期；The audit later revealed...给出相反事实；the evidence showed otherwise里的otherwise代替‘与理论预测不同’的情形。
exp.other: grant application 资助申请；merit 优点/实际价值；reviewer 评审员；reveal 揭示。
exp.meaning: otherwise在show/prove/suspect ... otherwise中常表示事实与此前观点不同；不只是‘此外’。
exp.rest: likewise表示同样，不能表达相反；meanwhile强调同时发生而非反证；therefore虽表因果，却不说明前述理论为何被推翻。

questions.q: After paving was replaced with porous soil, more rain entered the ground and less flowed into street drains. The report records no change to walls, fences or nearby buildings. Which explanation follows?
o: New barriers around the site kept river water out of the street.
Reduced surface runoff created the pores now found in the soil.
Porous ground reduced runoff by allowing more rain to soak in.
The change proves that nearby buildings now act as flood walls.

exp.trans: 铺装被多孔土壤替换后，更多雨水进入地下，流入街道排水口的水减少。报告没有记录围墙、栅栏或周边建筑的改变。能得到哪一种解释？
exp.structure: After交代材料改变；more...and less...呈现水流去向的对比；no change限制可以增加的解释。
exp.other: porous多孔的；runoff地表径流；drain排水口；soak in渗入。
exp.meaning: 材料特征使渗透条件改善，再减少地表径流；有利环境不等于周边存在保护性屏障。
exp.rest: barriers和flood walls都添加未有证据的保护结构；created the pores把结果当成材料特征的起因。

questions.target: 段尾问题 / 原因解释
questions.q:
前段：The theatre sold every seat at the advertised price. Yet the deposits in its bank account were smaller than the value of tickets sold. The manager began tracing the gap between bookings and payments.
哪个后段最能推进这一问题？
o: Audience surveys ranked music above scenery when asking about favourite parts of the performance.
The booking agency deducted its service fees before forwarding the remaining money to the theatre.
The theatre had used the same stage for years, although its audience changed with each production.
Rehearsals ended later than planned, so actors sometimes travelled home together.

exp.trans: 剧院按宣传价卖出了所有座位，但银行入账小于售票总额。经理追查订票与收到款项之间的差额。订票代理转款之前先扣除服务费，最直接解释这个差额。
exp.structure: The theatre + sold + every seat。deposits + were smaller than + the value of tickets sold是金额比较。正确后段中The booking agency + deducted + service fees；before forwarding说明扣款发生在剧院收到钱之前。
exp.other: deposit 入账款；advertised price 宣传价格；deduct 扣除；forward money 转款。
exp.meaning: 没有One reason或Equally等显眼连接词，也能由段尾的收款差额锁定后段的扣费机制。这是问题→原因，不是看见theatre或audience就接同主题段。证据来自金额和交易阶段，不是一个单词。
exp.rest: Audience surveys解释演出偏好，未说明钱款差额；same stage介绍场地历史，未接收款链；rehearsals和共同回家是演出活动信息，不解释代理转款前少了什么。

questions.target: 局部总结 / 段尾钩子
questions.q: A paragraph says: “Taken together, the short trials show that the sensor detects small leaks. That finding raises a further question: can it operate for weeks without a battery change?” Which next paragraph would best develop the hook?
o: A report of a month-long run and its power use.
A repetition of the first trial’s one-hour detection rate.
A history of the material used in the first sensor.
A claim that accurate detection already proves long battery life.

exp.trans: 一段写道：“短期试验合起来表明传感器能检测到小泄漏。这个发现引出进一步的问题：不换电池，它能否运行数周？”最能展开段尾钩子的是长达一个月的运行和耗电报告。
exp.structure: Taken together概括short trials；the sensor + detects + small leaks是that宾语从句。That finding回指检测结果。can it operate...?的问题将检测能力推进到长期供电能力。
exp.other: trial 试验；leak 泄漏；operate 运转；power use 耗电量。
exp.meaning: 局部总结不是全文封口。选下一段要回应新的运行时长问题，而非机械重复已总结的检测准确性。
exp.rest: one-hour detection rate只重复旧测试，未回答数周运行；material history转去材料背景，未接耗电问题；accurate detection proves long battery life把检测能力当成续航证据，两项指标不能自动互证。

questions.q: During a storm, walkers take shelter in a railway waiting room. Which meaning of shelter is relevant?
o: A small building intended primarily for keeping garden tools.
An area made darker only by blocking direct rays of sunlight.
Protection from bad weather, here provided by a waiting room.
The release of leaves from a tree during a seasonal change.

exp.trans: 暴风雨中，行人在铁路候车室避雨。shelter在这里对应什么含义？
exp.structure: take shelter表示寻求庇护；in a railway waiting room指出提供庇护的场所；during a storm给出需要保护的背景。
exp.other: walker步行者；waiting room候车室；primarily主要地；seasonal季节性的。
exp.meaning: shelter强调免受风雨或危险的庇护，既可说功能也可指场所；这里不要求该场所是专用避难建筑。
exp.rest: keeping tools描述shed常见名词义，却不是此处的保护功能；blocking sunlight只说明shade的遮阳方向；release of leaves是动词shed的另一语境。

questions.q: A report opens with one family losing its beans during a dry summer. It then follows seed banks that preserve many crop varieties, including ones not currently profitable. The final sections argue that these collections keep future farming options open when climates and diseases change. Which title best covers the report?
o: Why One Family Needs a Larger Vegetable Garden
Growing Every Crop Indoors Without Any Seeds
Saving Crop Diversity for an Uncertain Future
New Chemicals Make All Traditional Crops Obsolete

exp.trans: 开头是一家人的豆类歉收，但报告随后讨论种子库保留品种、在未来变化中保存农业选择的长期意义。
exp.structure: opens with表示例子入口；then和final sections说明后续主体及论点，不能以开篇人物替代全文。
exp.other: seed bank种子库；variety品种；profitable有利可图的；preserve保存。
exp.meaning: 标题须概括保存作物多样性及其未来价值，而不是只复述开头案例或单一技术。
exp.rest: One Family过窄；Indoors Without Seeds添加不存在的技术；All...Obsolete又把保存传统品种的主张改成淘汰。

questions.target: whatever + 名词 / 整体作宾语
questions.skill: 名词性结构与从句内部关系
questions.q: The registrar will accept whatever documents the applicant submits before Friday. What role does the underlined phrase play?
o: It is the object of accept: any documents the applicant submits.
It is the subject of submits and refers to the registrar.
It asks which documents the applicant may submit.
It modifies Friday and explains the reason for the deadline.

exp.trans: 登记员会接受申请人在周五之前提交的任何文件。whatever documents the applicant submits整体作accept的宾语。
exp.structure: 主句：The registrar will accept something。whatever documents the applicant submits before Friday整体替代something，作accept的宾语；the applicant submits是修饰documents的限定性关系结构，documents是submits的宾语。
exp.other: registrar登记员；applicant申请人；submit提交；deadline截止时间。
exp.meaning: whatever + 名词表示任何符合后续限定的该类事物；整个短语可以在主句中作宾语。要区分外层动词accept与内层从句谓语submits。
exp.rest: underlined phrase不是submits的主语，内层主语是the applicant；这不是直接疑问句；Friday是before的宾语，不是被whatever短语修饰的对象，也没有说明截止原因。

prompt_marks.text: whatever documents the applicant submits before Friday

questions.q: A cooperative chair mentions an eviction thirty years ago. The present petition, however, objects specifically to a new clause letting an outside firm terminate members' leases next year. Which reason does the petition actually give?
o: It seeks official recognition of the hardship caused decades ago.
It asks the outside firm to restore a historical community emblem.
It claims that renewed leases would prevent all cultural activity.
It challenges the firm's proposed power over members' future leases.

exp.trans: 合作社主席提到三十年前的一次驱逐。但当前请愿书明确反对一项新条款：外部公司可在明年终止成员租约。请愿书实际给出的理由是什么？
exp.structure: mentions只说明历史背景出现；however把焦点转向present petition；objects specifically及letting明确现在反对的条款内容。
exp.other: eviction驱逐；petition请愿书；clause条款；terminate a lease终止租约。
exp.meaning: 必须按本篇直接证据判断。历史出现不表示所有反对都只源于历史伤痛；这里明确写了将来的租约控制权。
exp.rest: official recognition把背景升级为请愿目标；restoring an emblem没有证据；文化活动全部受阻也不是租约条款的已述效果。

cloze-conditional-contrast.q: The auditor would order an independent recount ______ two consecutive inventory checks reported exactly the same suspiciously low number of errors. Which connective fits the stated condition?
o: if
until
though
unless

exp.trans: 如果连续两次库存检查都报告了可疑地相同且极低的差错数，审计员就会要求独立复核。
exp.structure: The auditor would order是主句；if引导条件从句，说明什么情形会触发重新清点；consecutive修饰两次盘点。
exp.other: auditor 审计员；inventory 库存；recount 重新清点；suspiciously 可疑地。
exp.meaning: if表示触发后续行动的条件；until表示动作持续到某一时间点为止，不能代替此处的判断条件。
exp.rest: until会改变主句行为的时间边界；though只引出让步而非触发条件；unless表示若不发生该条件则行动，与所需逻辑相反。

inference-boundary.target: 重新审视惯例 vs 无依据的未来结果
inference-boundary.skill: 推断必须有直接语义支撑
inference-boundary.q: An architect argues: 'When an old street layout fails its users, we should question the layout instead of assuming that pedestrians are the problem.' Later the article mentions plans to renovate the district. Which view is most directly supported by the architect's remark?
o: Old designs should be reconsidered when experience reveals their limits.
Every renovation will inspire a generation of future architects.
Pedestrian choices have no effect on city traffic.
New designs should always replace old ones, even when they work.

exp.trans: 建筑师认为，旧道路布局若不能服务使用者，就应质疑布局本身，而不是预设行人有问题。引文支持反思既有设计，而非预言未来创新的效果。
exp.structure: When从句给出条件；we should question A instead of assuming B是核心主张。Later句子另行交代翻修计划，但没有为引文添加未来代际因果关系。
exp.other: layout 布局；pedestrian 行人；renovate 翻修；reconsider 重新考虑。
exp.meaning: 引用某人的一句话，优先提炼这句话本身可支持的思考方式。与文章主题有关的后续结果可能合理，但若引文没谈到，就不能据此归给说话人。
exp.rest: 鼓舞未来建筑师引入未提及的影响链；完全否认行人作用和一律淘汰旧设计，都比原话更绝对。

inference-boundary.target: 思考方式 vs 后代研究因果
inference-boundary.q: A historian says of a newly revised account: 'The documents did not change; the questions I asked of them did.' The article later notes that her book was reprinted thirty years later. What does her statement most strongly suggest?
o: An influential book must be reprinted before its argument becomes valid.
Repeatedly publishing the same documents automatically produces new discoveries.
Revisiting familiar evidence with different questions can yield new interpretations.
The historian's method necessarily shaped every later generation of researchers.

exp.trans: 历史学家说：文献没有改变，改变的是我向它们提出的问题。这表明熟悉的证据也能因为新的提问方式产生新解释。
exp.structure: The documents did not change与the questions ... did形成对照；did代替did change，省略重复的动词原形change。后句reprinted thirty years later说的是再版事实，不包含对后代研究的必然影响。
exp.other: historian 历史学家；document 文献；reprint 再版；interpretation 解释。
exp.meaning: ‘旧材料+新问题→新解释’是引文直接支持的内容。后面提及多年后再版，并不能证明她影响了所有后来研究，更不能把时间先后直接改成因果。
exp.rest: 把再版当成论证有效性的必要条件属于添加规则；自动产生发现与提问改变的机制不符；对所有后代研究产生必然影响远超引文证据。

inference-boundary.skill: 行动证据与态度变化证据
inference-boundary.q: A tenants' group rallied 800 long-time supporters at a public hearing against a proposed rent increase. No survey of participants' earlier opinions was conducted. Which statement is warranted?
o: It converted former opponents into supporters of the group.
It mobilized supporters; a change of views is unproved.
It persuaded the city to cancel the proposed rent increase.
Most residents have shifted from support to opposition.

exp.trans: 租户组织动员了800名长期支持者，在公开听证会上反对拟议涨租。没有调查这些参与者以前的观点。只能确认组织动员了支持者，不能确认他们是被说服后改变立场。
exp.structure: A tenants' group + rallied + long-time supporters；No survey ... was conducted明确缺失了对以前态度的测量。Which statement is warranted要求只说证据足以支持的内容。
exp.other: tenant 租户；rally 动员；hearing 听证会；prior attitude 先前态度。
exp.meaning: rally supporters是组织已有支持者采取行动；change someone's political attitude要有前后立场变化的证据。动员和说服是不同关系。
exp.rest: 原文称参加者为长期支持者，没有原先反对的证据；未报告提案撤销；800名参与者也不能代表多数居民的态度转变。

inference-boundary.target: 态度确有变化 vs 是否由活动造成
inference-boundary.q: After a public campaign, a survey of the same 500 residents found support for the new bus plan had risen from 30% to 55%. During the same period, a fare cut was also announced. What is the most defensible conclusion?
o: The campaign explains the full rise in support for the plan.
Support rose; the campaign's separate effect remains unclear.
Residents' attitudes stayed the same despite the campaign.
The fare cut explains the full rise in support for the plan.

exp.trans: 一场宣传活动之后，对同一批500名居民的调查发现，新公交方案支持率从30%升至55%；与此同时还宣布降低车费。能确定支持率发生变化，但不能断定全由宣传活动造成。
exp.structure: a survey ... found + that支持率变化；During the same period引入另一同时发生的因素，阻止将全部变化归因于campaign。
exp.other: fare cut 降低票价；resident 居民；causal effect 因果效应；establish 证实。
exp.meaning: 这次确有前后态度数据，因此不能机械否认变化；但‘变化发生了’与‘某活动单独导致变化’仍是两回事。推断题要守住证据提供的层级。
exp.rest: 同群体前后调查证明支持率上升，但同期还有票价变化，不能把全部变化单独归给宣传或降价；态度未变则与调查结果冲突。

inference-boundary.q: An arts fund pays travel expenses for at most three performers in each selected troupe. The rest of the troupe may still take part at its own expense. Which inference is warranted?
o: Every funded troupe must contain at most three performers.
A troupe with four performers cannot enter the festival.
Only three performers from a troupe are allowed onstage.
The payment limit does not cap the size of a troupe.

exp.trans: 艺术基金为每个入选剧团最多三名演员支付差旅费，其余演员仍可自费参与。因此获资助人数的限制不等于剧团人数的上限。
exp.structure: at most three performers限定基金付费覆盖的人；第二句The rest仍可参与，明确区分资助范围与参与范围。
exp.other: troupe 剧团；travel expense 差旅费；at its own expense 自费；cap 限制上限。
exp.meaning: 数字出现后应先问“限制的是谁的什么权利”。对报销人数的限制不能移成对团队人数、报名资格或上台人数的限制。
exp.rest: “每团最多三人”“四人剧团不能参加”“仅三人可上台”都把差旅资助范围扩大成团队规模或参与资格限制，且忽略其余演员可自费参与。

inference-boundary.q: The director insists on formal titles and a clear chain of command. This explains why her staff describe her as hierarchical. Which conclusion is supported?
o: She values distinctions of rank within the workplace.
She takes a tough line in every wage negotiation.
She prevents junior staff from expressing any opinion.
She supports the same political party as her managers.

exp.trans: 主管要求使用正式职衔并保持明确的指挥层级，因此员工说她等级观念强。能确定的是她重视工作场所的等级区分。
exp.structure: The director是主语，insists on连接她强调的组织安排；This回指前句行为；describe her as hierarchical是员工对这种行为特征的概括。
exp.other: hierarchical 等级分明的、等级观念强的；chain of command 指挥链；take a tough line on 对某事采取强硬立场。
exp.meaning: 组织等级观念与具体议题上的立场强硬是不同判断。要把评价落实到原文给出的行为维度，不能因为某个形容词听起来强势就添加其他政治或谈判结论。
exp.rest: 谈判一概强硬、禁止下属发表任何意见、与经理支持同一政党都增加了原文没有提供的具体立场或限制。

inference-boundary.target: 情态强度 / 改选证据
inference-boundary.skill: 比较初选与改选的证据支持
inference-boundary.q: A memo says, "The council may consider giving street musicians a few extra evening slots." A reader first chooses "Extra slots are a possibility", then changes to "The council is now cutting performance time". No other evidence is given. Which judgment is warranted?
o: The revision fits because all new policies cut time.
The initial reading fits the proposal's uncertainty.
The revision fits because consider means implement.
The initial reading proves extra slots are certain.

exp.trans: 备忘录说，市议会可能考虑多给街头音乐家一些晚间时段。读者先理解为可能增加时段，后改为议会现在正削减演出时间。在没有其他证据时，初选与原句相符。
exp.structure: The council是主语，may consider是谓语，giving...是consider的宾语；giving结构中street musicians是接受者，a few extra evening slots是给予的内容。may同时保留考虑及执行上的不确定性；is now cutting则声称削减正在发生。
exp.other: memo备忘录；council市议会；slot时段；warranted有依据的。
exp.meaning: 改选必须有更强且相关的文本证据。这里extra表示增加，may consider不等于已经执行；改选同时改变了方向与确定性。结论来自证据匹配，不能归纳为一律坚持初选。
exp.rest: “新政策都削减时间”是无依据概括；“consider等于implement”混淆考虑与实施；“必定增加”也把可能性夸大成确定性。只有承认初选符合提议的不确定性才保留了原句边界。

inference-boundary.q: A music academy has confirmed two scholarship awards. Three other applicants still await an audition, and no decisions on them have been announced. Which inference is warranted?
o: All five applicants have already been given awards.
Every pending applicant will be refused an award.
Further awards are possible, but not yet confirmed.
The two confirmed awards have now been withdrawn.

exp.trans: 音乐学院已确认两份奖学金，另外三名申请者仍在等试演，尚无决定公布。因此，可能还有人获奖，但目前不能确认结果。
exp.structure: has confirmed表明已有结果；other applicants与still await把另一组人放在尚待处理阶段；no decisions...进一步排除对他们已有定论的说法。
exp.other: academy学院；scholarship奖学金；audition试演；pending待处理的。
exp.meaning: 等待某程序只说明状态，既不等于已获肯定结果，也不等于将获否定结果。可以保留可能性，不能把它升级为确定事实。
exp.rest: “五人全已获奖”把待试演者混入已确认者；“待处理者全会被拒”把未知变成必然；“原两份已撤回”增加了不存在的逆转。

inference-boundary.q: A seed bank has found incorrect labels in two boxes. Four more boxes are awaiting inspection; no results for them are available. What can be concluded now?
o: The other boxes may contain errors, but this is unconfirmed.
All six boxes have already been shown to carry wrong labels.
Every uninspected box must be free from labelling mistakes.
The first two findings prove that the inspectors were biased.

exp.trans: 种子库已发现两个盒子的标签有误，另外四个仍在等检查，尚无结果。其他盒子可能有误，但不能说已确认。
exp.structure: has found限定已知发现的范围为two boxes；Four more boxes是are awaiting的主语，待检查状态与no results共同标出证据边界。
exp.other: seed bank种子库；label标签；inspection检查；biased有偏见的。
exp.meaning: 已检查对象的结果不能自动外推给未检查对象。may保留可能性；already shown、must及prove都需要更强证据。
exp.rest: “六个都已证实标签错误”扩大已知范围；“未检查者必定无误”把未知反向说成确定；“发现错误证明检查者偏见”凭空增加了因果和动机判断。

inference-boundary.skill: 可能人选、选定与安排流程
inference-boundary.q: A hiring panel decided on a likely candidate for a vacant post and asked HR to arrange interviews. Which account is justified?
o: The panel selected a plausible applicant and asked HR to organize interviews.
The panel invented an imaginary applicant to delay the hiring process.
The panel postponed every interview until another vacancy appeared.
The applicant had accepted the post before the panel made a choice.

exp.trans: 招聘小组选定了一名可能合适的岗位人选，并请人力资源部门安排面试。原文支持“选出可能人选并安排面试”，不支持虚构人物或推迟招聘。
exp.structure: A hiring panel是主语，decided on是谓语，a likely candidate是宾语；for a vacant post限定候选人对应的岗位。asked HR to arrange interviews说明后续安排动作。
exp.other: vacant post空缺职位；candidate候选人；plausible看起来合适的；HR人力资源部门。
exp.meaning: likely candidate指可能合适的人选；decide on表示选定；arrange interviews表示安排面试。三个动作构成正常招聘流程。
exp.rest: imaginary applicant把likely误解成虚构并凭空添加拖延动机；postpone表示推迟，与arrange相反；候选人已经接受职位则把面试前的选择流程倒置成已录用。

inference-boundary.target: likely site / arrange talks / 未确认结果
inference-boundary.skill: 可能性与后续流程边界
inference-boundary.q: After comparing flood maps, planners selected a likely site for a clinic and arranged talks with nearby residents. The talks have not yet occurred. Which conclusion is justified?
o: They chose a possible site and arranged talks with residents.
They approved a final site after completing public consultation.
They invented a location to delay the construction work.
They cancelled the clinic because residents opposed it.

exp.trans: 比较洪水地图后，规划人员选定了一个可能的诊所选址，并安排与附近居民会谈；会谈尚未举行。可以确认的是他们选出了一个可能地点并安排讨论，不能说最终选址已批准。
exp.structure: After comparing...交代背景；主句planners selected... and arranged...有两个并列谓语。likely修饰site，说明可能性；The talks have not yet occurred明确后续会谈仍未发生。
exp.other: flood map洪水地图；site地点/选址；consultation协商；approve批准。
exp.meaning: likely site是可能的选址，不等于已经最终确定；arrange talks表示安排会谈，不等于会谈已经完成。
exp.rest: final site和completed consultation把可能性与未发生的会谈升级为已完成事实；invented a location凭空增加虚构动机；cancelled the clinic及居民反对均无文本依据。

inference-boundary.skill: 局部修改不代表整套方法失效
inference-boundary.q: A research team recalibrated one parameter in its climate model after finding a sensor bias. The remaining equations were kept, and the team continues to use the model. What follows?
o: Every principle of the model was declared obsolete.
All observations made with the model were erased.
The model remains in use after one limited adjustment.
The research team permanently abandoned modelling.

exp.trans: 团队因传感器偏差重新校准一个参数，其余方程保留，模型继续使用。
exp.structure: one parameter限定改动范围；remaining equations were kept说明其他部分未淘汰。
exp.other: recalibrate重新校准；parameter参数；obsolete过时的。
exp.meaning: 局部调整不等于整套模型失效，不能把一个参数变更扩大为全面废弃。
exp.rest: 整体报废、清除所有观察和全面放弃建模都超过原文证据。

inference-boundary.q: In a wildlife survey, three valleys showed fewer nesting birds this spring. The researchers had not yet examined the other valleys. What conclusion is justified?
o: Declines were recorded in the three surveyed valleys.
Every nesting bird in the region has disappeared.
The entire region is now unable to support birdlife.
All other valleys must have experienced larger losses.

exp.trans: 调查发现三个山谷筑巢鸟数量下降，但尚未调查其他山谷。
exp.structure: three valleys与not yet examined限制了证据范围。
exp.other: nesting bird筑巢鸟；survey调查；region区域。
exp.meaning: 部分样本变化不能推出整个地区或未经调查地点的确定状态。
exp.rest: 全部消失、生态全面崩溃和其他山谷损失更严重均未经证实。

inference-boundary.q: After six weeks, a pilot sleep programme improved participants' reported rest. No follow-up beyond the pilot was conducted. Which assessment is most defensible?
o: The programme permanently eliminates every sleep problem.
Short-term improvement is observed; durability is unknown.
The initial improvement guarantees lasting benefits.
The reported results show that the programme had no effect.

exp.trans: 六周睡眠试点显示主观休息改善，但没有更长期追踪。
exp.structure: After six weeks确定观察时间；No follow-up说明长期结论无证据。
exp.other: pilot试点；durability持续性；follow-up追踪。
exp.meaning: 短期改善是已报告事实，长期效果尚不能确认。
exp.rest: 永久解决、保证持久效果和完全无效都是错误扩大或否定。

inference-boundary.skill: 正确选项字母不具排除力
inference-boundary.q: A student has answered D on three consecutive questions. In the next passage, records show that a new filter reduced sediment in four tested streams; other sites were not studied. Which statement fits the passage?
o: The filter has restored every stream in the region.
The filter has already failed in all other streams.
Three previous D answers mean D must now be wrong.
The filter reduced sediment in four tested streams.

exp.trans: 前三题连续选D和本题无关；研究仅证明在四条已测试溪流泥沙减少。
exp.structure: records show提供已观察到的证据；four tested streams限定适用范围。
exp.other: sediment泥沙；tested经过测试的；consecutive连续的。
exp.meaning: 同一正确字母可以连续出现；应使用文本证据，不凭此前选项数量猜测。
exp.rest: 全区改善、其他地区全部失败和通过字母排除选项都没有依据。

inference-boundary.q: On a paper with no stated rule requiring balanced answer labels, an editor chooses a title that fits every paragraph, but explains: "I chose it because its answer label had not appeared in the previous questions." What is the soundest assessment?
o: The title may fit, but that label pattern supplies no textual support.
The unused label independently confirms the passage's central argument.
An unused label can decide between two equally plausible titles.
A title must be rejected if its label appeared in two earlier answers.

exp.trans: 编辑可能选中了符合全文的标题，但“这个字母此前没出现”不能为标题提供文本依据。结论与理由要分别核验。
exp.structure: 主句chooses描述选择；but转向其解释理由；because后给出的只是标签分布，未引用任何内容证据。
exp.other: assessment评价；label标签；scope覆盖范围；textual support文本支持。
exp.meaning: 碰巧选到合适选项，并不使错误的字母配平策略成立；争议题更应保留文本依据。
exp.rest: “独立证实主旨”和“用未出现字母决定标题”都把标签分布当作语义证据；看到重复字母就拒绝也是无依据的配平规则。

inference-boundary.q: A teaching article explains how software marks stress patterns in students' recorded speech. It then describes students becoming afraid to speak and recommends low-stakes rehearsal. A proposed title is "How the Software Calculates Every Score." What is the strongest reason to reject it?
o: The article gives no account of how the software identifies stress patterns.
Its procedural focus misses the article's concern about willingness to practise.
An unfamiliar word automatically makes a title unsuitable for this passage.
The same option label appeared too often in earlier questions on this sheet.

exp.trans: 文章确实解释了软件识别重音的机制，但后半部分主要讨论学习者不敢开口及低压力练习。程序教程型标题不能体现这一关切。
exp.structure: explains给出机制；then转向对学习行为的影响；recommends说明作者主张，须综合后两者确定中心。
exp.other: stress pattern重音模式；low-stakes低压力、非高风险的；rehearsal练习。
exp.meaning: 排除理由必须准确：局部机制已被介绍，正确的比较点是它是否构成全文主要论点。
exp.rest: no account否认了首句已提供的信息；unfamiliar word不能单独证明标题错误；earlier labels也不构成本文的内容证据。

inference-boundary.q: An archive stores paper in rooms cut into rock. Because the rock warms and cools slowly, room temperatures fluctuate less and the paper deteriorates more slowly. A visitor calls this an environmental advantage. Which assessment preserves the evidence?
o: The description wrongly rules out any effect of the local rock.
The local rock creates the stable conditions the visitor means.
Nearby buildings protect the archive from heavy road traffic.
The stable indoor climate has altered the shape of the local rock.

exp.trans: 档案馆把纸张存放在凿入岩石的房间里。岩石升温和降温都慢，因此室温波动较小，纸张劣化也较慢。访客称之为环境优势。怎样评价才保留了证据？
exp.structure: Because引出岩石热变化缓慢这一原因；室温稳定是形成的条件；纸张较慢劣化是结果。三层可以同时成立。
exp.other: archive档案馆；fluctuate波动；deteriorate劣化；thermal与热有关的。
exp.meaning: 称室内条件有利是合理的，不会否定岩石造成这些条件的原因。需判断完整表达，而不是强迫地理/物理原因与环境结果互斥。
exp.rest: wrongly rules out误判访客否定岩石作用；Nearby buildings及traffic添加未述的保护机制；“室内气候改变岩石形状”倒置了岩石特性与气候的因果方向。

paragraph-order-discourse.q:
段落甲结尾：Not surprisingly, nearly half of the applicants withdraw before the final interview.
下面哪个段首与它的衔接最强？
o: Equally unsurprisingly, few of the remaining applicants receive an offer.
By contrast, the final interviews take place in the company's new building.
For example, managers from several departments attend the final interview.
In conclusion, a final interview is unnecessary for applicants who remain.

exp.trans: 甲段说“不出所料，近一半申请者在终面前退出”。最强衔接是：“同样不足为奇的是，留下的人中也只有很少一部分收到录用。”
exp.structure: Not surprisingly先给出一个“并不意外”的结果；Equally unsurprisingly显式要求前面已经有一个同类判断，再补第二个并列结果。两个副词短语构成明显篇章钩子。
exp.other: withdraw 退出；final interview 终面；a small share 少部分；receive an offer 获得录用。
exp.meaning: Equally / similarly / also 等段首词常要求前文存在可并列对象。排序题中这种平行措辞比泛泛的主题相似更可靠。
exp.rest: 换到面试地点没有形成真正对立；经理参会不是申请者退出的例子；也不能从退出比例推出剩余申请者无需面试。平行标记与申请者筛选链共同支持承接。

paragraph-order-discourse.q:
一篇先分析家电过早报废、后提出改进办法的文章，有一候选段写道：After examining the figures, Dr Patel sums up her proposal: shared repair services could help residents keep appliances longer. 段末又说：Whether enough households will join, however, remains an open question.
这一段最适合放在哪里？
o: 全文开头，用来首次介绍Dr Patel
问题分析展开之前
全文结尾附近，作为总结和改革建议
只能放在具体数据段之前

exp.trans: 考察数据后，Patel博士总结自己的建议：共享维修服务或许能让居民更长久地使用电器。但是否有足够多家庭参与，仍是未决问题。这段最适合放在结尾附近。
exp.structure: After examining the figures回看前文数据；Dr Patel + sums up + her proposal明确给出总结动作。末句Whether...will join作主语，remains...为谓语部分，以未决问题收束。
exp.other: sum up 总结；shared repair service 共享维修服务；appliance 家电；household 家庭；open question 未决问题。
exp.meaning: 总结建议与回顾数据、开放结尾合起来支持尾段位置；单独出现concludes或sum up并不能证明必为全文最后一段。
exp.rest: 首次介绍人物不能解释已分析过数据；在问题分析前放总结建议与给定结构不合；“只能放在数据段之前”更与After examining the figures相反。

paragraph-order-discourse.target: 表面便利 vs 参与不足
paragraph-order-discourse.skill: 讽刺语气 + 对比过渡
paragraph-order-discourse.q:
前文：The online course called itself interactive, but students could do little more than click Next after each recorded lecture. The easiest part was operating the screen; the hardest was staying awake.
【空缺】
后文：What would genuine participation require? Students could challenge arguments and revise one another's work.
哪句最适合？
o: The simple controls already give learners an active role in shaping the course.
A redesign could replace passive viewing with a real role in shaping discussion.
Recorded lectures also let learners choose when to watch the same presentation.
Adding subtitles would make the recorded lectures easier for learners to follow.

exp.trans: 前文用带讽刺性的说法指出所谓互动课仍只让学生被动点下一页；正确句转向让学生真正贡献观点的另一种课程；后文追问真正参与需要什么。
exp.structure: but建立宣称interactive与实际只能click Next的矛盾；the hardest was staying awake暗示被动乏味。正确句用replace passive viewing with a real role in shaping discussion提出另一模式，后文再具体说明质疑论点与互相修改。
exp.other: interactive 互动的；lecture 讲座/课；challenge an argument 质疑论点；revise 修订。
exp.meaning: 看到操作很简单，不能自动判为作者赞扬。应结合转折、夸张和后文提问判断作者真正评价：被动消费不足，主动参与才是重点。
exp.rest: 操作简单不等于能参与建构讨论；自选观看时间和字幕提升观看便利，却没有补上后文要求的质疑论点、互评修改等主动参与。

paragraph-order-discourse.target: 单向展示→反向参与→后文设问
paragraph-order-discourse.q:
前文：At the old science museum, visitors watched a machine demonstrate each experiment. The most demanding thing they could do was press the Start button.
【空缺】
后文：What counts as taking part in an experiment? Visitors must be able to change a variable and compare the results.
哪一句最适合？
o: Repairs to the building could give the passive displays a more attractive setting.
Simpler controls could help more visitors watch the same machine demonstrations.
More detailed labels could explain the inventors behind the museum's machines.
A redesign could replace watching demonstrations with carrying out one's own tests.

exp.trans: 旧科技馆由机器单向演示，观众几乎只能按开始按钮。正确句引出新展览如何扭转这种被动观看，让观众亲自试验；后文再问什么才是真正参与实验。
exp.structure: 前文visitors watched与could do ... press Start显示参与程度低；正确句replace watching demonstrations with carrying out one’s own tests对比观看与亲自实验，后文change a variable和compare the results说明这种参与如何实现。
exp.other: demanding 费力的；demonstration 演示；variable 变量；carry out a test 进行试验。
exp.meaning: 最有力的证据是双向：反转被动的安排承接前文，主动测试又引出后文讨论。‘最难任务只是按按钮’在语境中揭示参与不足，不是对设备的夸赞。
exp.rest: 场馆外观、观看操作和发明者标签仍把参观者放在观看或接收信息的位置；只有亲自测试自然引出后文改变变量、比较结果的参与标准。

paragraph-order-discourse.target: new funding mechanism / That consequence / topical two-group distractor
paragraph-order-discourse.skill: 制度改革先说明执行机制，再由That引出合作结果
paragraph-order-discourse.q: A public library will stop funding children's and adult literacy programs through entirely separate budgets. Officials stress that the reform should strengthen both. [BLANK] That should produce more projects serving whole families, rather than two unrelated groups. Which fits?
o: The new process will require both programs to design projects together.
Regional libraries have published more reports about literacy this year.
Some employees focus on adult readers, while others teach children.
The board will create separate committees for each age group.

exp.trans: 图书馆计划取消儿童和成人识字项目完全分立的预算。改革目标是同时加强两者。随后要解释两项目如何一起设计方案，这才能使服务整个家庭的合作项目增加。
exp.structure: That回指空格中描述的具体做法；new process...design projects together才会自然导致projects serving whole families。两个研究群体的存在是话题背景，不是合作机制。
exp.other: literacy 读写能力；entirely separate 完全分开的；joint project 联合项目；committee 委员会。
exp.meaning: topic match≠discourse link：后句That should produce...是结果句，前句需要明确的行动或机制。如果只描述两个群体，读起来相关却没有形成因果链。
exp.rest: 发表报告不一定促进合作；成人/儿童分工只描述现状；继续成立独立委员会甚至背离整合改革的目标。

paragraph-order-discourse.target: policy integration / mechanism / This change consequence
paragraph-order-discourse.skill: 空前改革目标与空后合作效果需要中间实施步骤
paragraph-order-discourse.q: A museum plans to replace isolated conservation and education grants with a shared application process. Its directors say neither department will lose support. [BLANK] This change could generate exhibitions linking research and visitor experience. Which fits?
o: The museum has recently seen a sharp increase in visitor attendance.
Staff will evaluate proposals jointly and choose teams to collaborate.
The departments have long published very different research reports.
The museum will divide each grant into two fixed independent parts.

exp.trans: 博物馆将把保护和教育研究的独立资助改成联合申请。管理层说两部门都不会失去支持。空格要解释联合评审并选择合作团队，才能顺接‘这一变化会产生连接研究与观众体验的展览’。
exp.structure: 空格前提供改革背景和意图；This change could generate...给出预期效果。中间需要能产生该效果的具体协作措施，而非笼统主题描述。
exp.other: conservation 保护、文物修复；grant 资助；jointly 联合地；exhibition 展览。
exp.meaning: 要核实桥接是否构成‘政策→机制→结果’链条，不能因选项也谈博物馆或部门就草率接受。
exp.rest: 游客增加和以往报告差异只是主题信息；再把资金硬分成两部分反而违背联合申请改革。

paragraph-order-discourse.q: An energy guide first explains that meter logs locate periods of high demand. A paragraph about equipment inspections follows. The next two paragraphs describe a bakery and a warehouse that combined logs with inspections. What is the role of the inspections paragraph?
o: It completes the methods that the later cases apply.
It summarizes the outcomes reported in the later cases.
It gives a third case after the bakery and warehouse.
It withdraws the claim that meter logs can be useful.

exp.trans: 能源指南先解释用电表日志定位高需求时段，再介绍设备检查；后面两个案例同时使用日志和检查。检查段是在补齐随后案例会应用的方法。
exp.structure: first、follows、next交代段落顺序；combined logs with inspections说明两个案例同时依赖前面两种方法，不是只应用第一段的方法。
exp.other: meter log 电表记录；equipment inspection 设备检查；high demand 高需求；apply 应用。
exp.meaning: 一个方法段结束，不代表下一段必须马上举例。要检查后面案例需要哪些方法说明，再分清并列方法与两则应用案例的层级。
exp.rest: 总结后文结果需要结果性内容，检查方法本身不能当作结果总结；它位于两案例前也不是第三案例；案例同时使用日志，并未撤回日志有用的判断。

summary-location.q: A paragraph begins: “Overall, the first phase cut waiting times but raised operating costs.” The article then spends two more paragraphs discussing why costs rose. What does Overall most likely do here?
o: It announces the final conclusion of the entire article.
It sums up the first phase before further cost analysis.
It introduces an example unrelated to the first phase.
It signals doubt about the first phase's reported results.

exp.trans: 段落开头说：“总体来看，第一阶段缩短了等待时间，但提高了运营成本。”随后文章又用两段分析成本为何上升。这里 Overall 最可能是在进一步分析之前概括第一阶段的总体结果。
exp.structure: 引号内主干：the first phase（主语）+ cut / raised（并列谓语）+ waiting times / operating costs（宾语）。Overall修饰整句判断，表示概括性评价；后文仍可继续展开。
exp.other: phase 阶段；waiting time 等待时间；operating cost 运营成本；further analysis 进一步分析。
exp.meaning: Overall是句子/段落层面的总结副词，表示“总体而言”；它不等于“全文到此结束”。
exp.rest: 后文还要分析成本，不能判为全文终结；这句话概括第一阶段而非引入无关例子；Overall本身不表示对结果存疑。

summary-location.target: 总结范围 / 后续核验
summary-location.q: After presenting a commuter survey, a paragraph says: “To sum up, the new schedule suits many commuters. The council will review it after winter, when school travel patterns change.” What do these lines support?
o: The winter review has already overturned the survey findings.
The council has changed the discussion to the cost of new buses.
The paragraph summarises current findings and identifies a later check.
The survey has measured how school journeys changed during the coming winter.

exp.trans: 在呈现通勤调查后，一段写道：“总的说来，新时刻表适合许多通勤者。委员会将在冬季之后重新评估它，届时学生出行规律会变化。”这些句子总结当前发现，并提出之后的核验。
exp.structure: To sum up引入对已给调查的概括。The new schedule + suits + many commuters。The council + will review + it表达将来的评估；when从句补充冬后出行规律变化。
exp.other: commuter 通勤者；schedule 时刻表；review 重新评估；travel pattern 出行规律。
exp.meaning: 总结当前部分与计划未来检查可以同段共存；未来检查还未发生。单靠总结词或后续计划，不能保证这一段必为全文末段或必有下一段。
exp.rest: already overturned把未来复核改成已完成的推翻；cost of new buses凭空替换主题；has measured ... coming winter把尚未来到的时期说成已取得观测结果。

shed-shelter-shade.q: Every autumn this tree sheds its leaves beside the shed. Which reading preserves the two uses of shed?
o: The tree loses leaves; the noun names a small storage building.
The tree hides leaves; the noun names shade from direct sunlight.
The tree guards leaves; the noun means protection from bad weather.
The tree emits light; the noun names a clearing exposed to sunlight.

exp.trans: 每年秋天，这棵树在棚屋旁落叶。如何理解才保留了shed的两种用法？
exp.structure: tree是主语，sheds是谓语，leaves是宾语；介词beside后的the shed是名词短语。词性由句法位置区分。
exp.other: autumn秋天；beside在旁边；storage储存；clearing空地。
exp.meaning: 名词shed指小型储物棚屋，用户这一记忆本来正确；动词shed在leaves语境指脱落，不能把名词义套进谓语。
exp.rest: hides反转落叶动作且把名词当成shade；guards既非落叶又把shed当shelter；emits light虽可能是shed的另一动词搭配，却不适用于宾语leaves。

shed-shelter-shade.target: shade does not guarantee rain protection
shed-shelter-shade.skill: shade does not guarantee rain protection
shed-shelter-shade.q: A slatted cover shades a reading area at noon, but rain still passes through its gaps. What does shades indicate here?
o: Seals every gap so rain can no longer reach people underneath.
Blocks direct sunlight without necessarily keeping the rain out.
Turns the reading area into an enclosed building for tool storage.
Releases enough light to make the whole reading area much brighter.

exp.trans: 条板顶棚在中午为阅读区遮阳，但雨仍能从缝隙穿过。shades在这里表明什么？
exp.structure: shades是cover所做的动作；but把遮阳与不能完全挡雨并列对照，不能只保留有保护作用的宽泛印象。
exp.other: slatted由条板构成的；gap缝隙；underneath在下方；enclosed封闭的。
exp.meaning: shade在这里遮挡直射阳光。某些东西同时遮阳避雨是可能的，但此处遮阳不保证挡雨，须保留后半句限制。
exp.rest: Seals every gap与雨能穿过直接冲突；tool storage无依据地把功能改成shed；Releases light是散发光线，方向与遮挡相反。

shed-shelter-shade.q: A desk lamp sheds a warm glow while a screen shades the window. Which reading fits both verbs?
o: The lamp stores tools; the screen emits sunlight into the room.
The lamp hides its light; the screen creates a new storage shed.
The lamp loses its leaves; the screen provides a storm forecast.
The lamp gives off light; the screen blocks some incoming sunlight.

exp.trans: 台灯散发柔和光线，窗屏则遮挡窗外的光。哪种理解符合两个动词？
exp.structure: lamp与screen分别是两个动作主体；shed的宾语glow指实际光线，此处是散发义；shade的宾语window表明遮光。
exp.other: desk lamp台灯；glow柔和光线；give off散发；incoming进入的。
exp.meaning: shed可按宾语表示散发光等，shade在这里是遮光；字形相近不等于方向相同。此处也不要将字面发光一概替换为shed light on的阐明义。
exp.rest: stores tools把名词棚屋硬套进动词；hides反转发光；loses leaves忽略实际宾语glow；窗屏发光、建棚或预报天气也不符合原句。

title-coverage.target: 标题覆盖全文 / 局部主题
title-coverage.q: 短文先介绍图书馆除纸质借阅外的电子书、设备借用和线上课程，随后重点讨论线上课程的版权风险。哪个标题最能覆盖全文？
o: Copyright Problems in Online Courses
Beyond Printed Books: New Library Services
Why E-books Will Replace Libraries
The Only Safe Way to Teach Online

exp.trans: 文章先介绍图书馆在纸质书借阅之外提供的多种新服务，后文再重点讨论其中线上课程的版权风险。最合适的标题应覆盖多种新服务这一全文框架，而不是只概括后半部分。
exp.structure: 题干给出总框架到其中一项风险的篇章结构。标题需要同时解释前半部分为什么介绍多个服务，也能容纳后半部分的版权讨论。
exp.other: printed book 纸质书；device lending 设备借用；copyright 版权；cover 覆盖。
exp.meaning: 标题题要找能统摄全文的上位概念。局部篇幅很长，也不能因此把局部主题当成全文主题。
exp.rest: Copyright Problems in Online Courses只覆盖后半篇；Why E-books Will Replace Libraries加入取代主张；The Only Safe Way含Only且主题过窄。

title-coverage.target: 标题 / 全文发展主线
title-coverage.q: 短文追踪社区公共厨房如何从临时救灾供餐点转为日常共享备餐场所；中段介绍管理规则的变化，末段采访新加入的常住居民。哪个标题覆盖全文主线？
o: Who Uses Community Kitchens Today
From Emergency Meals to Shared Cooking
Rules for Running a Disaster Kitchen
Why Shared Kitchens Need New Buildings

exp.trans: 全文追踪公共厨房从灾时供餐到日常共享备餐的转变。From Emergency Meals to Shared Cooking意为“从应急供餐到共享烹饪”；其他标题分别聚焦当下使用者、灾时管理、未提到的新建筑需求。
exp.structure: 叙述按功能转变组织；规则变化和居民采访都是这一演变的证据。标题中的from...to...覆盖起点、终点及中间变化，而不仅是末段人物。
exp.other: emergency meal 应急供餐；shared cooking 共享烹饪；resident 常住居民；disaster 灾害。
exp.meaning: 全文覆盖可以体现时间或功能发展的主线，不必总列出多个并行服务。结尾采访显眼，但不应代替文章的发展轴。
exp.rest: Who Uses...只覆盖末段使用者；Rules for Running...只覆盖原有救灾角色的管理部分，漏掉转变；New Buildings引入未论述的建设需求。

title-coverage.target: 标题 / 比较框架与局部例证
title-coverage.q: 短文比较潮汐发电、屋顶太阳能、废热回收在沿海城市中的成本、时间限制与扩展条件。末段详细讨论废热管网维护，作为能源方案受当地条件影响的例子。哪个标题最好？
o: Maintaining Urban Heating Pipes
The Limits of Tidal Generation
Replacing Solar Panels with Recovered Heat
Energy Choices Shaped by Local Conditions

exp.trans: 文章比较三类能源方案的成本、可用时段与扩展条件，并用废热管网维护作例证。Energy Choices Shaped by Local Conditions是“由当地条件塑造的能源选择”。
exp.structure: 全文是多方案比较框架；末段维护细节从属于共同约束。标题中shaped by local conditions是修饰Energy Choices的过去分词短语，突出共同决定因素。
exp.other: tidal generation 潮汐发电；solar panel 太阳能板；recovered heat 回收热量；local condition 当地条件。
exp.meaning: 标题要覆盖比较对象及比较所得的共同轴线。篇幅较长的末段案例不等于全文唯一对象。
exp.rest: Maintaining...缩成末段管网维护；Limits of Tidal...只剩一种发电方式；Replacing Solar...虚构“以废热替代太阳能”的取舍结论，原文只说比较与条件约束。

title-coverage.target: 多阶段主题覆盖 / 防止只抓矛盾
title-coverage.q: A town once treated residents' road-hazard reports as isolated messages. It later built a system in which local volunteers gather reports, engineers check them, and officials publish verified travel advice. Advice is corrected when new evidence arrives. The town says repeated checking and revision—not merely the first report—has made the system dependable. Which title best covers the passage?
o: Why Local Volunteers Sometimes Make Mistakes
The Threat of False Reports at the Start of Every Journey
How Road-Hazard Reports Become Trusted Public Advice
A Debate over Whether Engineers Should Be Replaced

exp.trans: 小镇从最初零散的道路危险报告，发展到志愿者收集、工程师核查、官方发布，并根据新证据修订建议的流程。全文重点是信息如何逐步成为可靠的公共建议。
exp.structure: once ... later ... when ... 的时间和条件连接展开过程；最后一句not merely the first report强调可信度来自持续核查与修订。
exp.other: hazard 危险；isolated 零散的；verified 核实过的；dependable 可靠的。
exp.meaning: 标题需要覆盖‘初始信息→验证→公开→更新→可信’整条主线。仅强调最初的错误或一次争论，都只覆盖局部或无证据。
exp.rest: 志愿者犯错只是潜在局部问题；旅途中的虚假报告不是全文核心；替换工程师与原文分工核查相反。

title-coverage.target: 标题跨段覆盖 / 不凭字母分布
title-coverage.skill: 选择覆盖发展主线的标题
title-coverage.q: A school district began by collecting students' complaints about lunch menus. Nutrition staff then tested alternative recipes, while parents and kitchen workers assessed cost and acceptance. Several proposals were changed after trials. The district now repeats the evaluation each year rather than treating its first reform as final. Which is the best title?
o: The Hidden Cost of Hiring School Kitchen Workers
From Lunch Complaints to an Evolving Food Program
Why Students Reject Every Healthy Menu
A Final Recipe That Ended School Food Debates

exp.trans: 学区从收集学生对午餐菜单的意见出发，经过营养人员测试、家长和食堂人员评估、试行后修改，并每年继续复评。主线是餐食方案逐步形成并不断演进。
exp.structure: began by ... then ... after trials ... now ... each year组成完整发展顺序；rather than treating ... as final明确不是一次定案。
exp.other: nutrition staff 营养工作人员；alternative recipe 替代食谱；assess 评估；trial 试行。
exp.meaning: 最佳标题应包含问题提出、集体检验和持续改进。不能因为某个字母此前少出现，就放弃更能覆盖全文的选项。
exp.rest: 雇员成本只是局部评估维度；every healthy menu属于无依据的绝对化；final recipe与每年重新评估矛盾。

title-coverage.target: 标题覆盖 / 核心事件
title-coverage.skill: 核心行动与话题相关性辨析
title-coverage.q: A city bus operator is testing overnight bicycle parking at three depots. The article explains how the trial works, cyclists' responses, and staffing limits. Nearby repair shops appear only as background. Which title best captures the article's central event?
o: Cyclists Turn to Bus Drivers for Help with Bike Repairs
City Bus Depots Host an Overnight Cycle-Parking Trial
Bicycles Become Part of the City's Transport Mix
Every Bus Depot Opens Permanently for Cycle Storage

exp.trans: 城市公交运营方正在三个车场试行夜间自行车停车服务。文章介绍试行办法、骑车者反应和人员限制，附近修车店只是背景。标题应概括公交车场试行夜间自行车停车这一事件。
exp.structure: 首句主语A city bus operator，谓语is testing，宾语overnight bicycle parking；at three depots限定试点范围。后两句区分围绕试行的主体内容与仅作背景的修车店。
exp.other: operator运营方；depot车场；overnight过夜的；staffing人员配备。
exp.meaning: 标题要保留核心主体、行动及试行性质，并能统领实施、反应和限制。仅与自行车或交通话题相关，不足以概括文章。
exp.rest: “公交司机帮忙修车”把背景改成主要行动；“自行车进入城市交通组合”虽话题相关，却遗漏夜间停车试行；“所有车场永久开放”同时扩大three和testing的范围、确定性。

title-coverage.target: 主旨标题 / 行动与原因
title-coverage.skill: 概括全文发展而非抓相关词
title-coverage.q: Local bookshops are replacing separate next-day deliveries with a slower shared service. The article explains rising van costs, pooled routes, and customers accepting longer waits for lower delivery charges. A brief section about authors' visits supplies background. Which title best captures the main development?
o: Online Shopping Reshapes Relations with Local Shops
Local Bookshops Abandon Online Orders and Deliveries
Book Launches Become the Main Job of Delivery Teams
Bookshops Pool Deliveries to Lower Transport Costs

exp.trans: 当地书店正用速度稍慢的共享配送取代各店分别进行的次日配送。文章分析货车成本上涨、合并线路以及顾客接受较长等待来换取较低配送费；作家来访只是背景。主线是书店通过合并配送降低运输成本。
exp.structure: 首句主语Local bookshops，谓语are replacing，宾语separate next-day deliveries，with引出替代方案。第二句explains后列举改革原因、运作方式及顾客反应；最后一句明示作家活动只是背景。
exp.other: pooled routes合并安排的线路；van厢式货车；delivery charge配送费；background背景。
exp.meaning: 一个标题若能同时统领成本原因、共享做法和顾客取舍，比只罗列相关话题更准确。概括不能把改用另一种配送扩大为停止线上业务。
exp.rest: “网购改变与商店的关系”相关但过于宽泛，遗漏合并配送降成本的核心变化；“放弃网购订单和配送”与仍有shared service矛盾；“送货团队主要举办新书活动”把背景细节升级成主旨，并加入无依据的团队职责。

title-coverage.target: title coverage / 核心争议对象
title-coverage.q: At a university, hiring panels have long treated publication counts and institutional prestige as the main signs of academic merit. A new proposal gives more weight to teaching, mentoring and contributions to local research groups. Critics argue that the old measures overlook important work, especially by early-career scholars. Which title best captures the central issue?
o: A Challenge to Universities' Ideas of Academic Merit
Another Debate About Competition in Higher Education
Why Young Scholars Are Leaving University Research
A New Ranking System for Research Universities

exp.trans: 大学招聘长期把论文数量和机构声望当作学术价值的主要标志。新方案提高教学、指导学生和本地研究贡献的权重，批评者认为旧标准忽略重要工作。核心是挑战大学对学术价值的既有定义。
exp.structure: 首句交代既有评价标准；第二句提出新方案；第三句由Critics argue引出中心批评。
exp.other: publication count论文数量；institutional prestige机构声望；academic merit学术价值；early-career scholar职业早期学者。
exp.meaning: 正确标题同时覆盖被挑战的主体（大学）和争议对象（学术价值标准），而不是只摘取一个局部案例。
exp.rest: 有的选项只说高等教育竞争，范围过宽；有的声称年轻学者正在离开研究岗位，原文没有此事实；还有的把新评价方案误写成已经建立的新排名系统。

title-coverage.q: A city library has been judged mainly by the number of books borrowed. A new review argues that this measure misses digital help, language classes, and access for residents who cannot visit during the day. It asks the city to reconsider what a successful library provides. Which title best represents the argument?
o: Rethinking How Cities Measure Library Success
Why Borrowing Books Has Declined in City Libraries
A Plan to Replace Libraries with Online Services
The Growing Cost of Running Public Libraries

exp.trans: 一座城市图书馆过去主要按借阅量评价。新评估指出，这一指标忽略数字服务、语言课程以及白天无法到馆居民的使用机会，因而要求重新思考什么才算图书馆成功。
exp.structure: 首句给出旧指标；第二句指出其遗漏；第三句概括中心诉求。
exp.other: borrow借阅；digital help数字服务；access使用机会/可及性；measure衡量指标。
exp.meaning: 核心不是借阅量下降、线上服务取代图书馆或运营成本，而是成功标准需要重新衡量。
exp.rest: 借阅量下降并未被报告；用线上服务取代图书馆超出原文；把成本当成核心问题也偏离文章。

title-coverage.q: A city tested reflective roofs to reduce summer heat. The report says roofs helped, but shaded bus stops, drinking-water access and support for elderly residents must also be included in a wider plan. Which title best captures the point?
o: How Reflective Roofs Became the City's Only Heat Tool
Why Elderly Residents Have Stopped Using Public Buses
The Falling Price of Roof Materials in Urban Markets
Citywide Heat Planning Beyond Reflective Roofs Alone

exp.trans: 反光屋顶有用，但高温应对还需遮阴、饮水和老人支持。
exp.structure: but把主旨从单项措施引向综合方案。
exp.other: reflective反光的；shade遮阴；response应对。
exp.meaning: 标题要涵盖由局部措施向综合应对转变的论点。
exp.rest: 唯一措施、老人停止公交和材料降价均偏离原文。

title-coverage.q: An online learning platform recommends courses using past clicks. Researchers say this may help discovery, but ask for clearer explanations and a way for students to override the system. Which title fits best?
o: Why Online Courses Should Be Abolished for Everyone
Making Course Suggestions Clearer and Easier to Control
The Complete History of University Enrollment Systems
How Student Click Data Has Become Entirely Useless

exp.trans: 研究者认可基于点击的推荐有一定用途，但要求透明解释和学生自主改选。
exp.structure: may help discovery肯定实用性；but ask for指出核心改进诉求。
exp.other: recommend推荐；override人工覆盖；transparent透明的。
exp.meaning: 标题应强调推荐系统更透明和可控，而非全面放弃线上课程。
exp.rest: 废除课程、招生历史和点击数据全无用均不是论点。

title-coverage.skill: 方法论中心而非局部例子
title-coverage.q: Cafeterias have traditionally counted leftover food only by weight. A study finds that this hides differences between discarded meals, preparation scraps and food safely donated. It recommends separate measures for each. Which title best reflects the study?
o: Why Students Always Leave Food on Their Plates
The Cost of Replacing All School Kitchen Equipment
Measuring Food Waste More Precisely Across Its Sources
A Call to Stop Donating Leftover Food to Local Groups

exp.trans: 报告认为只按重量统计食物浪费不够，应分别衡量餐食、备菜边角和捐赠。
exp.structure: traditionally交代旧法，It recommends呈现主要主张。
exp.other: cafeteria食堂；scraps边角料；discard丢弃。
exp.meaning: 标题需要涵盖衡量方法的改进和分类原则。
exp.rest: 学生总剩饭、替换所有设备或停止捐赠都无证据。

title-coverage.skill: 识别转折后的核心议题
title-coverage.q: A charity celebrates a rise in volunteer sign-ups. Its annual review notes, however, that most newcomers leave within a month and argues for mentoring and flexible shifts. Which title best captures its concern?
o: From Volunteer Recruitment to Keeping Volunteers Engaged
The End of Volunteer Work in Modern Communities
Why Charities Have Stopped Recruiting New Workers
An Unprecedented Surge in Long-Term Volunteer Loyalty

exp.trans: 志愿者招募增多，但新人很快退出；报告要求导师指导与灵活排班。
exp.structure: however将主题从招募成绩转移到留存问题。
exp.other: sign-up报名；mentoring指导；retention留存。
exp.meaning: 标题应概括招募和留存之间的落差与解决方向。
exp.rest: 终结志愿服务、停止招募、长期忠诚度增加均不真实。

title-coverage.target: paragraph core goal vs illustrative measure
title-coverage.skill: 主旨判断：整体任务与具体例子
title-coverage.q: A neighbourhood group first surveyed why families rarely used a public park. It found poor lighting, inaccessible entrances and a lack of seating. The group then proposed fixing those barriers and measuring whether more residents return, rather than simply holding one publicity event. What heading captures the main point?
o: A Guide to Advertising One Weekend Event
Why Park Volunteers Need More Members
Remove Barriers to Everyday Park Use
The History of Street Lighting Projects

exp.trans: 社区调查公园少有人使用的原因，发现照明、入口和座椅问题，建议解决这些障碍并评估使用效果。
exp.structure: surveyed why... 和 fixing those barriers指向找原因并改善可用性；宣传活动只是对照。
exp.other: inaccessible难进入的；barrier障碍；usable可使用的。
exp.meaning: 标题应覆盖对使用障碍的调查和改善，而不是抽一个局部措施当作全篇主旨。
exp.rest: 单次活动广告、招募人数、照明史均不是本段总体论点。

title-coverage.q: A city installed hundreds of nest boxes after birds stopped breeding in several parks. Some boxes remained empty. Researchers then found that night lighting disrupted feeding and that insect numbers had fallen. The writer welcomes the boxes but argues that nesting space is only one part of the problem. Which title best captures the argument?
o: Urban Birds Need More Than Extra Nest Boxes
Nest Boxes Have Ended the Decline of City Birds
How Carpenters Build the City's Nest Boxes
Why All Wild Birds Now Leave Cities Forever

exp.trans: 城市增设巢箱后，一些箱子仍空着。后续发现夜间照明和昆虫减少也影响繁殖；作者认可巢箱，但指出单一措施不够。
exp.structure: 前两句给出措施及局限；then引出另外的原因；welcomes...but argues明确作者最后的限定主张。
exp.other: nest box巢箱；breeding繁殖；disrupt扰乱；feeding觅食。
exp.meaning: 标题要包含单一解决办法不足以覆盖多种原因的论点，不能把受到欢迎的措施直接写成已经解决全部问题。
exp.rest: Have Ended夸大为问题已解决；How...Build只写建设方法；All...Forever加入全文不支持的绝对结论。

title-coverage.q: Residents were throwing away repairable clothes because they lacked sewing skills. A cooperative linked volunteer tailors with neighbourhood workshops, shared spare materials and taught simple repairs. The passage spends most of its space explaining how that network works and ends by recommending similar networks elsewhere. Which title fits best?
o: Why Every Modern Fabric Wears Out Too Quickly
A Repair Network Gives Old Clothes a Second Life
The Small Tools Carried by One Volunteer Tailor
How Clothing Brands Set Prices for New Collections

exp.trans: 居民缺乏缝补技能而丢弃可修衣物。合作社把志愿裁缝、社区工坊和剩余材料联成网络，文章主要介绍网络做法并建议推广。
exp.structure: because交代起初的问题；linked、shared、taught展开方案；most of its space和ends by recommending说明全文重心。
exp.other: cooperative合作社；tailor裁缝；spare剩余的；repairable可修复的。
exp.meaning: 此处方案型标题有全文展开和结论支持，不能机械认为问题型标题一定更全面。
exp.rest: Every Fabric把技能问题改成所有面料质量问题；One Tailor的工具袋只是可能细节；品牌定价没有被讨论。

title-coverage.q: An essay begins with a song that attracted millions of brief plays. It contrasts that success with a small community choir whose listeners attend repeatedly and form lasting friendships. Rather than dismiss streaming, the author asks whether listening totals alone capture music's social value. Which title best expresses the point?
o: Why Streaming Platforms Need Many More Users
One Singer's Guaranteed Route to a Viral Hit
How Streaming Apps Compress Digital Audio Files
Beyond Listener Counts: What Makes Music Matter

exp.trans: 文章从高播放量歌曲写起，对比社区合唱团带来的持续参与和友谊，质疑单靠播放量能否衡量音乐的社会价值。
exp.structure: contrasts构成案例对比；Rather than dismiss排除全面否定平台的读法；whether引出作者质疑的评价标准。
exp.other: choir合唱团；brief短暂的；lasting持久的；social value社会价值。
exp.meaning: 流媒体只是话题之一，核心论点是评价标准是否过于单一，标题要体现这一层。
exp.rest: More Users仍只追求数量；Guaranteed Route把引例误作操作教程；Compress Audio讨论技术细节而非社会价值。

nested.skill: who 定语从句 + that 宾语从句 + 主句谓语
nested.target: who 定语从句 / that 宾语从句
nested.q:
Applicants who believe that a longer résumé automatically proves greater ability often overlook the value of relevance.
哪组句法判断正确？
o: 主句主语 Applicants；who 从句谓语 believe；主句谓语 overlook
主句主语 Applicants；who 从句谓语 proves；主句谓语 believe
主句主语 a longer résumé；who 从句谓语 believe；主句谓语 overlook
主句主语 Applicants；who 从句谓语 believe；主句谓语 proves

diag.1: proves 属于 that 宾语从句，不是 who 从句的核心谓语；believe 也不是主句谓语。
diag.2: a longer résumé 是 that 从句内部的主语，不是整句主语。
diag.3: proves 是 that 从句谓语；整句主句谓语是 overlook。

exp.trans: 那些认为简历越长就自然能证明能力越强的申请者，往往忽视了“相关性”的价值。
exp.structure: 原始简单句① Applicants often overlook the value of relevance. ② Applicants believe something. ③ A longer résumé automatically proves greater ability. → ②把 something 换成 that 从句：Applicants believe that... → 再把②变成修饰 Applicants 的 who 定语从句：Applicants who believe that... often overlook...。所以整句主语 Applicants，who 从句谓语 believe，that 从句谓语 proves，主句谓语 overlook。
exp.other: applicant 申请者；résumé 简历；automatically 自然而然地/自动地；relevance 相关性。
exp.meaning: 看到 who 后先划到从句结束，再找主句谓语；who 从句里又可嵌套 that 宾语从句。
exp.rest: 把 that 从句的谓语 proves 误当成外层谓语，或把其中的 a longer résumé 误当成整句主语，都会错过：Applicants 是主句主语，believe 是 who 从句谓语，overlook 是主句谓语。

nested.target: who 定语从句 / that 宾语从句
nested.skill: who 定语从句 + that 宾语从句 + 主句谓语
nested.q:
Residents who discovered that the shared gate was unlocked called the caretaker.
按“主句主语中心词 / who从句谓语 / 主句谓语”的顺序，哪组正确？
o: Residents / discovered / called
the shared gate / discovered / was
Residents / was unlocked / discovered
the caretaker / called / discovered

exp.trans: 发现公共大门没有锁上的住户给管理员打了电话。
exp.structure: 简单句①Residents called the caretaker. ②Residents discovered something. ③The shared gate was unlocked. → 把③接在discovered后：Residents discovered that the shared gate was unlocked. → 把重复的Residents换成who并嵌入①：Residents [who discovered [that the shared gate was unlocked]] called the caretaker。主句完整主语包含who从句，中心词是Residents。
exp.other: resident 住户；shared 共用的；unlocked 没锁上的；caretaker 管理员。
exp.meaning: 发现这件事的是住户；没有锁上的是大门；打电话给管理员的还是住户。三个小句的主语和谓语不能串层。
exp.rest: the shared gate只在that从句中作主语，不能升为主句主语。was unlocked属于that从句，discovered属于who从句；两者都不是主句谓语。the caretaker是called的宾语，不是发现大门未锁的人。

nested.skill: 区分定语从句、宾语从句和主句谓语
nested.q: Engineers who noticed that the valve was leaking shut down the line. Which sequence gives the main-clause subject head / who-clause verb / main-clause verb?
o: Engineers / noticed / shut down
the valve / noticed / was leaking
Engineers / was leaking / noticed
the line / shut down / noticed

exp.trans: 注意到阀门漏液的工程师关闭了生产线。按题目要求的顺序，主句主语中心词是Engineers，who从句谓语是noticed，主句谓语是shut down。
exp.structure: 主句骨架是Engineers shut down the line；who noticed...修饰Engineers；that the valve was leaking是noticed的宾语从句。三个谓语分别属于不同层级。
exp.other: engineer 工程师；valve 阀门；leak 漏液；shut down 关闭、停运；subject head 主语中心词。
exp.meaning: 先找主句骨架，再把who定语从句和that宾语从句分别嵌入。阀门是that从句的主语，工程师才是主句主语。
exp.rest: the valve只在that从句中作主语；was leaking属于that宾语从句，不是who从句谓语；the line是shut down的宾语，不是主句主语。

nested.skill: 区分定语从句、宾语从句和主句谓语
nested.q: Editors who learned that the quote was inaccurate removed it from the draft. Which sequence gives the main-clause subject head / who-clause verb / main-clause verb?
o: Editors / learned / removed
the quote / learned / was
Editors / was / learned
the draft / removed / learned

exp.trans: 得知引文不准确的编辑把它从草稿中删掉了。主句主语中心词是Editors，who从句谓语是learned，主句谓语是removed。
exp.structure: 主句骨架是Editors removed it from the draft；who learned...修饰Editors；that the quote was inaccurate是learned的宾语从句。三个谓语属于不同层级。
exp.other: editor 编辑；quote 引文；inaccurate 不准确的；draft 草稿。
exp.meaning: 先找主句骨架，再把who定语从句和that宾语从句分别嵌入。quote是that从句的主语，Editors才是主句主语。
exp.rest: the quote只在that从句中作主语；was属于that宾语从句，不是who从句谓语；the draft是介词from的宾语，不是主句主语。

nested.target: whatever + 名词 / 嵌入式修饰结构
nested.skill: 名词短语内部结构与主句宾语
nested.q: The workshop lets each visiting researcher retain whatever equipment they brought for the project. Which analysis is accurate?
o: The phrase is the subject of lets and refers to the researcher.
The whole phrase is the object of retain; whatever determines equipment.
The phrase is a direct question asking what equipment was brought.
The phrase modifies workshop and explains why the visit occurred.

exp.trans: 工作坊允许每位来访研究人员保留自己为项目带来的任何设备。whatever equipment they brought for the project整体作retain的宾语。
exp.structure: 主句骨架：The workshop lets each visiting researcher retain something。whatever equipment they brought for the project替换something，整体是retain的宾语；whatever限定equipment，they brought for the project修饰equipment。
exp.other: workshop工作坊；visiting researcher来访研究人员；retain保留；equipment设备。
exp.meaning: whatever + 名词可表示“任何……/所……的任何东西”。先识别整个名词短语在主句中的位置，再分析短语内部的限定词和修饰从句。
exp.rest: 主句主语是The workshop，不是whatever短语；这里不是直接疑问句；whatever短语不修饰workshop，也不说明访问原因。

historical-reminder-evidence.q: A theatre plans to restore a factory emblem above its entrance. Former workers object: the emblem recalls public punishments imposed by that factory decades ago. They raise no objection to the theatre's rent or ownership. What grounds their objection?
o: The emblem recalls humiliating treatment experienced in the past.
The theatre will give another company control over current rents.
The restoration will end local access to adult education courses.
The workers expect the old factory to reopen under new ownership.

exp.trans: 剧院计划恢复入口上方的工厂徽记。旧工人反对，因为徽记让他们想起几十年前工厂施加的公开惩罚。他们没有反对剧院租金或所有权。反对基于什么？
exp.structure: object后用冒号解释理由；recalls将现在的符号与过去的屈辱经历相连；raise no objection进一步排除当前租金或产权作为已述理由。
exp.other: emblem徽记；impose施加；humiliating令人屈辱的；ownership所有权。
exp.meaning: 当前物件可以唤起过去的伤痛；不能把这条历史记忆证据自动改写成现实租金、教育机会或控制权变化。
exp.rest: current rents与原文否定的对象冲突；结束成人教育和工厂重开均未被陈述。不能仅因这些担忧现实中可能发生就当成本文理由。
